name: Iterative method
definition_zh: 反复更新近似解直到满足给定条件的求解方法。
usage_overview: 用于求解轨道及其耦合系统中的非线性平衡问题，通过反复更新响应、系统矩阵或接触状态，并依据残余力修正位移，使力的平衡与位移协调逐步满足求解要求。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, the direct iterative method and incremental method are used to calculate the static deformation of the track system.
In order to deal with the multinonlinearity of the system properties, an iterative method of vehicle–track system is adopted at each time-step.
method; Iterative method 随着轨道交通不断深入国民日常生活,轨道结构的平顺状态越来越受到铁路运营管理及研究人员的关注 [1]。
